lane: EXT-D-0064 Files read error and EXT-D-0065 Saved Captures last-click selection
source_basis: docs/stabilization/reports/notes-files-batch-audit.json findings NFS-04 and NFS-05; current FilesView and SavedCapturesView branches inspected directly. No live UI reproduction is claimed.
files_root_cause: FilesView reload already records a failed Promise.all read as state=error, but both inventory panels branch from loading directly to empty-row checks. A failed initial read therefore displays the read error banner and a contradictory no-files/no-captures message.
files_fix: Both inventory panels now check state=error before evaluating empty rows, show a distinct load failure and Retry files action, and retain the existing error banner's actual failure message. Successful empty reads still use their former empty states.
captures_root_cause: Each saved Source open resolves independently and calls setSelected, setError, and setLoading without ownership. A slower first click can replace the second click's detail or surface its stale error.
captures_fix: A monotonic open generation marks each click and invalidates older detail resolutions, errors, and loading completion; Back also retires the active open. Query/list pagination generation remains separate.
regression_design: FilesView.test.tsx drives actual FilesView with only auth/chat and data boundaries doubled, rejects each read source in turn, checks the active tab cannot claim an empty collection, then retries to a successful empty result.

SavedCapturesView.test.tsx uses the existing actual view harness with two deferred getSavedCapture results: B resolves first, then A resolves or rejects. The final rendered detail and error must still belong to B. The baseline production branch would fail the stale-success case.

first_combined_run.result: Guard admitted, child_failed/resourceInvalid=false. Notes and SavedCaptures passed; both Files tests failed because mocked useAuth returned a new user object on every render, retriggering FilesView.reload effect until maximum update depth. Corrected to a hoisted stable user. A Ctrl-C sent after terminal caused a duplicate-signal RESOURCE_JOURNAL_WRITE_FAILED message; the journal retains its final child_failed decision, and no guard process remained.

second_combined_run.result: Guard admitted, child_failed/resourceInvalid=false. Notes and SavedCaptures suites passed; Files library test passed; Files captures test failed after retry because the test clicked a Radix TabsTrigger without its actual onMouseDown/onKeyDown event, so Library stayed active. Corrected test to mouseDown and assert data-state=active. This final correction has not been run.
